findings.source: IEEE 802.1Q-2022 (and 802.1Q-2018) define MSRP FourPackedEvents in 35.2.2.7.2 with Table 35-3; there is no 35.2.2.7.4
Table 7-156 is IEEE 1722.1-2021's STREAM_INPUT counters_valid table; Milan v1.2 lists the Stream Input counters in Table 5.6 (5.3.8.10)
findings.correction: Write IEEE 1722.1-2021 Table 7-156 (Milan v1.2 Table 5.6).

findings.source: Same as D0-007: Table 7-156 belongs to IEEE 1722.1-2021
findings.correction: Write the IEEE 1722.1-2021 Table 7-156 stream counters, in the section description and its Contents entry.

findings.quote: Bare-metal firmware publishes PHY state into LiteX `milan_mac.link_status`.
findings.source: `sw/firmware/milan_baremetal/milan_baremetal.c` lines 1086-1094: `phy_link_tick()` runs inside `nvm_heartbeat_tick()`, which returns until `nvm_started` (line 1668) is set; a refused record-set shape never sets it
findings.correction: Add that publication runs only while the saved-state writer runs; otherwise MAC_STATUS keeps its reset value (link up, 1000 Mb/s, full duplex).

findings.source: `hdl/common/csr/milan_csr.sv` lines 885-897 (`A_ETH_GUARD` at 0x7D8), 1578 (reset armed), 1731 (write rule), 2389 (readback); the map has no 0x7D8 row, against REQ-CSR-01's acceptance
findings.correction: Add `0x7D8 ETH_GUARD`: RW, reset 1 (armed); writing 0x554E4C4B disarms, any other write re-arms; while armed PHY_RESET writes are dropped and LINK_CTRL[1] is masked; the link guard's own recovery is not gated.

findings.source: `hdl/common/csr/milan_csr.sv` line 2692 drives `o_phy_reset_n` and line 1688 drops writes while ETH_GUARD is armed; `sw/litex/milan_soc.py` never connects the datapath's `o_phy_reset_n`; the pin is driven by LiteEth's CRG reset CSR (`sw/litex/patches/0002-liteeth-gmii-tx-clk-invert.patch`, `pads.rst_n` from `self._reset`)
findings.correction: Document PHY_RESET as inert in the shipping SoC, and document `milan_mac_phy_crg_reset` (LiteX CSR) as the reset that reaches the PHY for the `--eth-port` the image is built for.
